headline: GB Global Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: GB Global Limited has formally notified the NSE of an amalgamation or merger transaction; specific parties, consideration, and structure are subject to the full regulatory filing.
implication: An NSE-filed merger announcement triggers mandatory disclosure and compliance with Companies Act § 230–232 (merger scheme), NCLT approval, and stock exchange listing rules; practitioners must verify NCLT sanction order and minority shareholder votes.
detail: GB Global Limited announced an amalgamation/merger by formal disclosure to NSE on 14 August 2026. The transaction has been publicly notified via official exchange channels. Full details of the transferee company, consideration, share-swap ratio, and statutory approvals are contained in the referenced NSE filing.
